verdict.rationale: Meltano's CLI is explicitly documented as the tool for scaffolding (`meltano init`), configuring/adding plugins (`meltano add`, idempotent), and testing/inspecting config (`meltano config test`, `meltano config list`) — all headless, scriptable operations well suited to an agent. Orchestration/scheduling (Airflow) and containerization further support running complete pipelines non-interactively. missing for 10: no explicit `meltano run` pipeline-execution command evidence, no REST/OpenAPI-based API (probe returned 404s), and no direct evidence of an agent-driven end-to-end run.
